build_x86_graph: build a graph from an x86 assembly file using Graphs_build_x86 with asm_file and task arguments
load_asm_file: load an assembly file and return a bag-of-words token list using load_asm_file with a file path
find_basic_blocks: find basic block labels and function names in assembly content using find_header with a string
create_node: create a Node object with name, node_id, node_type, and ins_id for graph representation
create_edge: create an Edge object with name, edge_type, src, and tgt for graph connections
